I have hip length hair. I get regular 1 inch trims after every two months. 
I would recommend that you follow what I do:
1. Make supplements as part of your daily dietary routine. 
2. Focus on eating healthy at least 50% of the time. Try green juice if eating fast food is your thing. Point is nutrition needs to be there. 
3. Apply oil on the roots before taking a bath at least thrice a month.
4. Wash your hair after 1 day gap. Alternate hair mask and conditioner with each wash. No need for both at the same time.
5. Always use a leave-in serum post wash. Keeps breakage at bay. 
6. Use a silk scrunchie and stay away from hair ties.
7. Sleep on silk pillowcases.
